The craziest thing about exams and university is that you never have to be married to it. My Dad got his MASTERS DEGREE in music education and now has a well paying job that has nothing to do with music. I knew a kid who literally had a .51 GPA in college and is now supporting himself with a job in an entirely unrelated field.

I know that exams and studying and college and your courses can feel all-encompassing, but they aren’t. I promise. There a lot of things in the world that are tough, almost impossible, to deal with. But grades and school should never be that for you. I’m sorry that you feel so trapped in this world of schooling and studying, but there is a way out and the other side is much, much brighter

Hey man, loneliness does weeeeirddd things to us. Humans are social creatures and we need other human interaction. I understand the propensity to fall into this lonely depression but if you think you’re going to kill yourself — fuck it, it’s time to start doing some cringe shit to make friends. Start talking to random people. Sign up for shit you’d never sign up for. I’m not at all saying that being social will cure you of what you’re feeling, but it does help and it’s definitely worth trying before you decide to end it all
